files.name: dochi_cobblemon_editor-0.2.8-neoforge-1.21.1.jar
files.html:
0.2.8 Change Log

  • Added DNPC support for Pokémon Itself, Poké Mart, Nurse Joy, and starter Pokémon.
  • Added temporary hand-held item visuals and improved profile persistence.
  • Linked DNPC clones to the Clone Library, Spawners, and Battle Scheduler.
  • Fixed trainer detection icons and improved Nurse Joy AI behavior.
